name: Portland Chess Club
note: Competitive and casual chess club hosting tournaments and casual play. Meets Tuesday and Thursday at 7:30 PM and Saturday at 2:00 PM.

name: Lucky Lab
note: Casual chess meetup hosted by Portland Chess Association on Mondays and Sundays. Restaurant/pub with food and drinks available.

name: Living Häus Brewery
note: Casual chess meetup every Tuesday from 5-9pm with 15 chess sets provided. Brewery with beer and food available.

name: Lazy Days Brewing
note: Chess meetup every Thursday evening with 4 chess sets provided. Brewery restaurant with food and beverages.

name: Director Park
note: Urban park with life-sized chess board featuring 3-foot tall pieces. Staff brings out pieces daily at 2pm.

name: Coffee Time
note: Popular casual chess cafe where players gather in the evenings and on weekends, especially Saturday nights. Coffee shop with cozy seating.

name: Chess Club
note: Retail store and design lab selling global magazines, design books, and more. Chess-themed retail space.
